name: Champion pick is one of the 48 FIFA 2026 teams
description: When the Final match page surfaces the predicted champion, the named team is one of the 48 teams returned by the teams API.

planSteps.description: Read the list of team names from the response
Read the match id whose stage label is F or Final
Navigate to /match/<final-id> using the captured id
Verify the champion block names a team that appears in the 48-team list returned by /api/teams
